AMAZON $AMZN AND AMERICAN ELECTRIC POWER $AEP ARE EVALUATING A 960-MEGAWATT NUCLEAR PLANT IN INDIANA

The plant would use a new reactor design that hasn't been proven yet - Bloomberg https://t.co/a3TVsKsogT

I was told AI was over.

$GOOG just announced $17 billion for its first data center in Wyoming, two days after Democrats won the House and Senate.

Almost the entire press release is about the local community. Google pays for 100% of its own power. The site is air-cooled to save water. Carbon gets captured and stored nearby. Google expects hundreds of millions in local property taxes, met with 200+ residents, and set up a community council with its partners.

$BE is the only supplier named in the announcement. It’s providing 702 MW of fuel cells through $AEP and has a seat on the community council. 

I believe Bloom benefits the most, since local communities now have more say over how data centers get built, and fuel cells keep the power off the local grid while cutting emissions and water use.
